details:
Q1: What should this issue's PR cover?
Choices:
A) Only the code change: the `review_autofix.yml` skip on the `force_rb_judge` path, plus regression tests and docs. Filing the fresh heal issue and closing #6733 happen outside this PR, through the existing heal intake/report path. The PR body links #6733 with `Refs #6733` and has no auto-close keyword. (RECOMMENDED)
B) A, plus changes to `scripts/workflow_failure_heal_intake.sh` / `scripts/workflow_failure_heal.py`, so intake can re-file a successor heal issue for a heal issue whose scope marker is missing, and close the predecessor once it has verified the successor.
C) A, with the PR body set to `Closes #6733`, so #6733 closes when the PR merges.
**Note:** C closes #6733 whether or not a verified successor exists, which conflicts with "link the verified successor and close #6733".
Q2: Which failure markers count as "trusted same-head" for skipping the conflict steps?
Choices:
A) The newest `review-autofix-failure:v1` marker on the PR, posted by the account authenticated through `GH_PAT` (the existing `AUTOFIX_FAILURE_MARKER_AUTHOR` identity), with `head=` exactly equal to the current PR head SHA and `reason=` exactly `conflict_resolver_sandbox_path_host_only`. (RECOMMENDED)
B) Same as A, but accept the reason in any of the same-head markers, not only the newest one.
C) Same as A, but also accept markers from `github-actions[bot]`.
Q3: What should happen when trust can't be checked (identity lookup fails, comment history can't be read, or the marker is malformed)?
Choices:
A) Run the conflict steps as today. The sandbox still refuses host-only paths and hands off to a human, so nothing becomes less safe; log a reason token for the fallback. (RECOMMENDED)
B) Skip the conflict steps anyway and go straight to the review-blocked judge.
C) Fail the run.
Q4: Which failure reasons should trigger the skip?
Choices:
A) Only `conflict_resolver_sandbox_path_host_only`, as the issue says. (RECOMMENDED)
B) Every reason in `NON_RETRYABLE_FAILURE_REASONS`, which adds `conflict_resolver_sandbox_path_unsupported` and `conflict_resolver_sandbox_support_missing`.
